Membership

Our Membership delivers a fully integrated healthcare experience for under $17 per month (*billed annually at $200). Members receive access to top primary care physicians collaborating closely with nutrition and mental health experts, along with functional wellness, movement, and modern technology—all working together in one personalized, holistic system.

Your Complete Care,
From Prevention to Recovery

  • Primary Services

Baker Health’s curated specialty network connects Members to highly vetted, top-tier specialists who meet our standards for access, quality, and trust.

Through established relationships and coordinated referrals, Members are seen quickly, stay in-network, and experience seamless, high-quality care guided by Baker Health every step of the way.

Not a portal. Not a call center.

Baker Health has built the only app designed for true concierge care—offering 24/7 real-time messaging with your doctor and care team, seamless scheduling and reservation changes, and on-demand access to personalized wellness content.

We’ve reimagined healthcare delivery—and put it in your pocket.

Baker Health offers Members a comprehensive approach to longevity medicine, starting with a complimentary consultation with a functional medicine doctor (Dr. Cortney Goodtstadt) at our Clifton location.

Members also gain access to discounted Extension Health services, including advanced testing, personalized health insights, and actionable strategies to optimize long-term wellness.

We want to empowers Members to proactively manage their health, enhance vitality, and extend quality of life.

At Baker Health, holistic expertise is mandatory for all our doctors.

Everyone of our doctors is certified in functional and lifestyle medicine, food-as-medicine, and breathwork through top programs like Harvard, Yale, etc. ensuring that every Member receives care that combines cutting-edge medical science with personalized, integrative wellness strategies.

 

Award Winning Doctors

Baker Health hires fewer than 10% of the doctors who apply. Our roster includes not only chief residents and professors from Ivy League institutions but also some of the most respected and sought-after names in healthcare. These physicians are celebrated for their exceptional patient care, groundbreaking research, and leadership in their respective fields. Continuously advancing their expertise, they participate in cutting-edge clinical trials and contribute to influential medical publications. Their unwavering commitment ensures that Baker Health delivers the highest standard of medical services. By fostering a culture of excellence, our team remains dedicated to improving patient outcomes and setting new benchmarks in healthcare. Read More

24/7 Doctor
Chat

Imagine if your best friend or family member were your Doctor. Instead of waiting to see them to request a refill, you could simply text them, and they would respond immediately and compassionately, 24/7. That’s the kind of care Baker Health Members experience. Our seamless communication platform ensures that your health concerns are addressed promptly, no matter the time of day. Whether you have a question about your medication or need advice on managing a condition, our dedicated doctors are always available to assist you. This level of accessibility fosters a stronger patient-doctor relationship and promotes better health outcomes. At Baker Health, we prioritize your well-being by making expert medical support just a message away. Read More

Same Day Reservations

On the 4th of July, Thanksgiving Day, or any Sunday, when you need your Doctor the most, we’re here for you. Baker Health Members can see their Doctor in person 365 days a year and & 7 days, as well as digitally 24/7. We guarantee that you and your family will always be seen on the same day. Our flexible scheduling system is designed to handle urgent appointments without compromising on quality care. Whether it's a sudden illness or a pre-planned consultation, our team ensures that your medical needs are met promptly. Additionally, our seamless booking platform makes securing a same-day appointment quick and easy, so you can receive the attention you deserve when it matters most. At Baker Health, we prioritize your well-being by providing reliable and immediate access to our top-tier healthcare professionals every day of the year. Read More

No Wait Time

A doctor without a waiting room..because there is no waiting. Your time is valuable. Sometimes you need a rapid response, and other times a virtual visit is the solution. At Baker Health, we honor your reservations precisely at your scheduled time, unlike typical doctor's appointments which are anything but. Our streamlined scheduling system ensures that your appointments begin promptly, eliminating the frustration of unexpected delays. Whether you require immediate medical attention or a convenient routine consultation, our efficient processes accommodate your needs seamlessly. By prioritizing punctuality, we respect your schedule and enhance your overall healthcare experience. With Baker Health, you can trust that your time is valued and your care is delivered without unnecessary waits. Read More

Complete Care Coordination

Annual Fitness Assessment at Fenix

As part of your Membership, you receive an annual fitness assessment at a concierge gym based in Englewood, NJ. This hyper-evaluated fitness assessment provides a personalized regimen tailored to your current fitness level and your physical goals.

Discounted Prenuvo Whole Body Scan

As part of our commitment to proactive healthcare, Baker Health Members can enjoy discounted Prenuvo scans for early disease detection. These quick, non-invasive whole-body scans help you stay ahead of potential health issues, empowering you to take control of your well-being with confidence.

Elevate the Way You Live

As part of your Membership, you gain access to physician-guided vitamin infusions and targeted nutrient injections. These personalized treatments are formulated to optimize energy, strengthen immunity, support metabolism, and enhance recovery each tailored to your unique health goals and deficiencies for measurable results.

Baker Studio

All Members can enjoy free yoga, pilates, meditation, & fitness classes led by some of the highest-quality instructors. Led by our Director of Yoga and Wellness, explore the mind-body connection through yoga, breathwork, meditation, and self-discovery in a Baker Health Studio or virtually on the Baker Health App.

Frequently Asked Questions

Will my Membership dues actually save my family money? Expand

Yes. Statistics indicate that nearly half of American families visit urgent care or emergency rooms due to limited access to their primary care physician. The average co-pay or deductible for an urgent care or ER visit ranges from $75 to $150, significantly higher than the cost of primary care visits.

Are there unexpected or “are you serious” expenses? Expand

A fundamental principle of our model is that families are spending too much on inefficient and fragmented care. We accept and are in-network with all commercial and private insurances to ensure accessible healthcare for everyone.

How does my Baker Health Membership improve my family's health? Expand

Your Baker Health Membership improves your family’s health by providing comprehensive, accessible, and personalized care. You get guaranteed same-day reservations for you and your family, along with access to holistic services including nutrition counseling, mental wellness support, fitness programs, yoga, and more.

Do I always see the same doctor? Expand

Our approach is centered on fostering consistent, ongoing relationships that collaborate with you on your health and wellness journey. You can always choose to see the same doctor.

Are you open on holidays and weekends? Expand

Your health is our top priority every day of the week. Our commitment to accessibility means you can avoid the ER and urgent care, as we're here for you 365 days a year, both in person and virtually.

What do I do if there is an emergency after hours? Expand

Baker Health has no after-hours—we're available year-round, 7 days a week, with in-person visits and 24/7 virtual care. No matter the time of day, whether you're abroad or on vacation, you'll have direct access to your doctor and care team for guidance in any emergency.

What do I do if I need to see a specialist? Expand

Whether it’s a dermatologist, cardiologist, or gastroenterologist, the Baker Health network of specialists is composed of high-quality, in-network experts we know and trust, with immediate access.

Do I have to be a Member to join Baker Health? Expand

Yes. After a free 1-month trial that enables you to make sure we are the right home for you and/or your family, you become a Member of Baker Health and are privy to all the differentiated features that solve the broken aspects of the present healthcare experience.

Do I have to be a Member to use the Baker Health App? Expand

Yes. The Baker Health app is a comprehensive healthcare platform that includes fitness, medication, yoga content, seamless scheduling, and, most importantly, provides direct 24/7 access to your doctor, helping to alleviate anxiety. As a result, the app is exclusively available to Members.

How much is the Membership cost for the Baker Health app? Expand

The Baker Health app provides a membership option designed to suit your preferences and budget. Choose the yearly plan for $200, offering significant savings and uninterrupted access to all features for the entire year. With this plan, you’ll enjoy the full range of tools and support the app has to offer, ensuring your health goals are always within reach. Start your journey today with Baker Health!
